points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 艾达·洛夫莱斯在伦敦出生，并度过了她的早年生活。她的父亲是著名的诗人乔治·戈登·拜伦，母亲安娜·拜伦是一位数学爱好者。艾达在母亲的指导下接触到了数学和科学，这为她后来的成就打下了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Ada Lovelace was born in London and spent her early life there. Her father was the famous poet George Gordon Byron, and her mother, Ann Byron, was a mathematics enthusiast. Ada was introduced to mathematics and science by her mother, which laid the foundation for her later achievements.

points.title: 与查尔斯·巴贝奇的合作
points.description: 艾达·洛夫莱斯与数学家和发明家查尔斯·巴贝奇合作，共同研究他的差分机和分析机。她为分析机编写了著名的算法，被认为是世界上第一个程序员。
points.descriptionEn: Ada Lovelace collaborated with the mathematician and inventor Charles Babbage on his Difference Engine and Analytical Engine. She wrote a famous algorithm for the Analytical Engine, which is considered to be the first computer program.

points.title: 去世
points.description: 艾达·洛夫莱斯在伦敦去世，享年37岁。她的去世对科学界是一个巨大的损失，但她的遗产和贡献在后来的世纪中被重新发现和高度评价。
points.descriptionEn: Ada Lovelace died in London at the age of 37. Her death was a great loss to the scientific community, but her legacy and contributions were rediscovered and highly valued in later centuries.

supporter.zh: 艾达·洛夫莱斯被视为计算机科学的先驱，她的算法被认为是现代计算机编程的基石。她的贡献在于她超越了当时对机械计算的理解，预见了计算机的潜力。
supporter.en: Ada Lovelace is regarded as a pioneer of computer science, with her algorithm considered to be the foundation of modern computer programming. Her contribution lies in her surpassing the understanding of mechanical computation of her time and foreseeing the potential of computers.

critic.zh: 批评者可能会指出，艾达·洛夫莱斯的工作在很大程度上是基于查尔斯·巴贝奇的研究，她的贡献可能被高估了。此外，她的工作在当时并未得到足够的认可。
critic.en: Critics might point out that Ada Lovelace's work was largely based on Charles Babbage's research, and her contribution may have been overestimated. Moreover, her work did not receive sufficient recognition at the time.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，艾达·洛夫莱斯被视为一个具有前瞻性的思想家，她的工作对后来的计算机科学产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，她经常被描绘为一位天才女性，象征着女性在科技领域的潜力。
objective.en: In the academic community, Ada Lovelace is seen as a forward-thinking thinker whose work had a profound impact on subsequent computer science. In popular culture, she is often portrayed as a genius woman, symbolizing the potential of women in the field of technology.

self.zh: “我确信，一旦机器被发明出来，它将能够执行任何数学运算。”
self.en: "I anticipate that the machine will be able to execute any mathematical operation."

others.zh: “艾达·洛夫莱斯不仅是数学家，也是一位诗人，她的心灵充满了数学的韵律。”
others.en: "Ada Lovelace is not only a mathematician but also a poet; her mind is filled with the rhythm of mathematics."
